Edit this file, not the code. claimed_edge is the bot's DOCUMENTED expected return per trade as a fraction of the capital committed to that trade (null = no documented figure, the bot can be shown but never picked). evidence_pts / price_pts are the bot's own scores from claude/bot-confidence-scores-2026-10-25.md (out of 35 and 20). status: live | paper | shadow | superseded | unreadable.
